CREATE INDEX idx_date_dim_year ON date_dim(d_year, d_date_sk);
CREATE INDEX idx_store_sales_date_store ON store_sales(ss_sold_date_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_cdemo_sk);

WITH filtered_customer_demographics AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
),
filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
)
SELECT i_item_id, s_state, grouping(s_state) g_state, avg(ss_quantity) agg1, avg(ss_list_price) agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) agg4
FROM (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_quantity, ss_list_price, ss_coupon_amt, ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_customer_demographics ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_date_dim)
) AS filtered_sales
JOIN store ON filtered_sales.ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
GROUP BY i_item_id, s_state WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
